procedure: Identify actual reviewer/channel and scope without spawning or simulating review.
Inspect originals, model and dominant assumptions independently when the host supplies that channel.
Challenge alternatives, ownership and method divergence.
Bind findings and any actual recheck closure to current hashes.

acceptance.expectation: Reviewer metadata records observed facts and distinguishes author checks from independent review.
Challenge addresses economic adequacy and conclusion strength, not just arithmetic.
NCI, consolidation, leases and share rights are tested against actual perimeter and alternatives.
Closure follows inspection of revised artifacts, never author relabeling.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction
